Ho cercato a lungo un materasso che fosse sufficientemente grande per potersi muovere liberamente e allo stesso tempo con un materasso abbastanza spesso da dormire qualche giorno in più senza rinunciare alla comodità. Questo lettino, robusto e comodo, racchiude una serie di specifiche davvero uniche che lo rendono il migliore in assoluto. (Piccolo suggerimento da ingegnere: provate ad applicare un materasso spesso 14cm senza allungarlo, ma con una rete più lunga di 8cm, saranno le misure che acquisterò volentieri visto il risultato praticamente perfetto)
Best folding bed on the market. Feels like a single bed. Highly recommended.

The product served our purpose. The mattress is quite soft but thickness is acceptable. The metal grid frame provides good support. We added posture board under the mattress to make it more comfortable. The construction, wheels is flimsier than version than I expected.
This is an excellent item. Very high quality and it can carry an amazing amount for being so portable. We use it constantly and with nothing but positive results.
Good quality bigger than I thought, easy to put up

Live in Chicago and decided to put this on my terrace. Chicago gets VERY windy, so I was nervous it would get knocked over, but it’s been holding up like a champ. I do have about 800 lbs. of sand from Home Depot weighing it down - and yes, I did this setup myself. I absolutely love relaxing in it at night and especially when it rains. No leaks at all! One tip: make sure you layer the bottom with another tarp/rug depending on the surface you have it on to help avoid water coming through from underneath. I plan on leaving it up year-round. It’s been up since March and still going strong.
This has been fantastic! Used daily in winter. Held up well and kept the weather out.
Easy to assemble, no extra tools required. It’s really convenient for anyone to set up.

We really love this sink. It looks modern, elegant, and made our bathroom look much more updated. The size is perfect and it was exactly what we were looking for. It also feels sturdy and easy to clean. Very happy with this purchase.
